title: 📣 McLean, VA Sales & Marketing Jobs with Multiple $150K+ Roles - NewsBreak
text:
7 hours ago McLean is buzzing with marketing roles right now, from hands-on social media work to big-league leadership jobs with six-figure pay.
Here are several standout Sales & Marketing openings hiring in McLean, VA :
Marketing Assistant (On-Site / Local & Immediate Need) Employer: SnugFit Solutions (Xyken LLC) – leader in mobile 3D imaging for orthotics & prosthetics Location: McLean, VA (on-site, local only) Type: Full-time Salary: Not listed Support a fast-growing health tech company with social media, email, content creation, and online marketing. Ideal if you love crafting posts, testing new ideas, and want lots of responsibility and growth early in your career.
Senior Director, Marketing Performance and Growth Employer: Hilton Location: McLean, VA (corporate office, on-site) Type: Full-time Salary: $175,000 – $230,000 + bonus + long-term incentives Build and lead a new marketing performance team to make Hilton’s global media and digital investments work harder. Great fit for a 12+ year marketing leader who loves data, ROI, media optimization, and cross-functional influence.
Regional Marketing Manager Employer: Flik Hospitality Group (Compass Group USA) Location: McLean, VA (on-site 3–4 days/week, regional travel 20–30%) Type: Full-time Salary: $105,000 – $110,000/yr + 10% additional comp Be the regional voice of the brand , turning corporate strategy into on-the-ground marketing for hospitality and dining accounts. Mix of strategy and hands-on execution, with a company car , strong benefits, and ownership over regional campaigns.
Manager Communications 2 (Employee Communications) Employer: Northrop Grumman Location: McLean, VA (on-site, not remote) Type: Full-time Salary: $133,100 – $199,700 Lead internal communications for Defense Systems, advising senior leaders and managing a team to keep employees informed and engaged. Great for a strategic communicator who enjoys storytelling, executive messaging, and complex, high-impact projects.
